high_level_description: The image shows a person standing outdoors on what appears to be an airport tarmac or a similar paved area. The individual is wearing a long, red dress with a floral pattern at the hem and cuffs. The dress has a fitted bodice and a flowing skirt that reaches the ground. The person's hands are placed on their hips, and they are wearing high-heeled shoes with a black and white patterned design and teal-colored toes. In the background, there is a large aircraft parked on the tarmac.
